theorems.name: Submission.dmr_massMeasure_support_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)), IsMassMeasure X μ → μ X.supportᶜ = 0 ∧ (X.mass < ∞ → IsFiniteMeasure μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
